_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Bo ta hunga Klondike Solitaire. Bo meta ta pa move tur kart pa e pila di fundashon.

Reglanan di Wega:
- Pila di fundashon (F1-F4): Konstruí desde As te Rei den suit
- Pila di tablero (T1-T7): Konstruí abou ku koló alterna (koru riba preto, preto riba koru)
- Stock: Tira kart pa e pila di waste
- Waste (W): E kart di ariba disponibel pa hunga

Komandonan:
- 'draw' - Tira kart for di stock pa waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Move kart entre pila
  Ehempel: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count tambe por ta 'all', ku lo intenta move tur kart ku ta wak.
- 'forfeit' - Kaba e wega inmediatamente i sera bo skor aktual
- Nòmber di pila: W (waste), F1-F4 (fundashon), T1-T7 (tablero)

Bo por ehekutá aksiononan múltiplo den un turno pa separá nan ku komma:
  Ehempel: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Solamente Rei por ta poní riba pila di tablero bashí.
Aksiononan ta ehekutá den órdu - si un faya, e aksiononan restante ta saltá.
Usa 'forfeit' si bo kere ku e wega ta imposibel pa gana.
